decision: Close KIOTA-RECURSOR-TYPE-DESIGN-1 with a complete source-bound ordinary, mutual and nested reconstruction design, a fail-closed definitional-equality-plus-replacement rule, and four exact preservation fixtures plus the inherited reject-candidate/accept-control pair. Select KIOTA-RECURSOR-TYPE-REPAIR-1 READY and unstarted because the exact implementation inputs and regression matrix are now locally bound and this repair directly removes the highest-value remaining trust path.

categories.assessment: The design item resolved its fixed question positively by locating the complete already archived Lean 4.33.0 construction and mapping it to Kiota's native term, universe and conversion APIs. The next useful method step is the separately gated implementation, not another design pass.

The exact source hashes, construction stages, comparison rule, four accepted fixtures and one-scalar negative/control pair are now reusable implementation assets. Runtime preservation and the full-suite result remain intentionally unobserved until the repair protocol passes.

A local production repair is now design-ready but still requires a fresh committed work record, exact patch, independent review and supervised tests. No upstream action is authorized; a tested local result must precede any recommendation.

The selected repair reuses pinned Kiota source, the provenance-bound Lean 4.33.0 kernel algorithm, predecessor source policy, exact pair audit and existing Kiota fixtures. No network or new authority source is required for entry.

Implementation is the direct remaining blocker to removing downstream dependence on serialized recursor types. The broader trust-assumption reporting pilot still lacks its exact six-fixture expectation and two-path integration protocol, so it remains less feasible and less direct.

candidates.rationale: READY and unstarted under a dedicated implementation plan. The exact target source, complete algorithm, comparison rule, preservation fixtures and negative/control pair are content-bound. Entry requires a fresh work record and protocol before production edits or launches.

The reporting question remains valuable but is not mechanically ready and does not remove the immediate recursor trust path. Its six fixtures, expected transitive sets, two observable report paths and staged integration contract remain unbound.

blockers.reason: Bind the exact six fixtures, expected transitive assumption sets, two observable report paths and staged integration protocol before promotion.
